method: Native C++ Wasmtime host (same pinned Wasmtime library) and Node V8. Paired O2 direct builds and fresh-process Wasm probes, shuffled cells and within-pair variant order. One untimed fresh-process warmup per cell/variant. Entrypoint includes initialization, host output callbacks and lazy JIT. Both variants write timing files after engine intervals; instrumented process wall is diagnostic, not the headline example metric.
